scripts.build-call-shape.py:
from pathlib import Path
import shutil,re
root=Path('/tmp/gma-bottosson-investigation-be03abd')
s=(root/'current/src/bottosson-factory.js').read_text()
a=s.index('function findGamutIntersectionQ (');i=s.index('{',a);start=i+1;depth=1;i+=1
while depth:
 if s[i]=='{':depth+=1
 elif s[i]=='}':depth-=1
 i+=1
body=s[start:i-1]
body=re.sub(r'\bcuspL\b','cusp[0]',body);body=re.sub(r'\bcuspC\b','cusp[1]',body)
body=body.replace('else {','else {\n const q0 = a * KA0 + b * KB0;\n const q1 = a * KA1 + b * KB1;\n const q2 = a * KA2 + b * KB2;',1)
helper='function findGamutIntersectionAb (a,b,l1,c1,l0,cusp) {'+body+'}\n\t'
s=s[:a]+helper+s[a:]
old='findGamutIntersectionQ(unitA * KA0 + unitB * KB0, unitA * KA1 + unitB * KB1, unitA * KA2 + unitB * KB2, L, C, L0, cusp[0], cusp[1])'
assert s.count(old)==1
s=s.replace(old,'findGamutIntersectionAb(unitA, unitB, L, C, L0, cusp)')
dest=root/'original-call-shape';shutil.copytree(root/'current',dest,symlinks=True)
(dest/'src/bottosson-factory.js').write_text(s)

scripts.bootstrap.py:
# Reproduce the investigation using the scripts embedded in its evidence JSON.
# Usage: python3 bootstrap.py REPORT.json REPOSITORY NEW_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
from pathlib import Path
import sys,json,subprocess,tarfile,io
report,repo,root=map(lambda x:Path(x).resolve(),sys.argv[1:])
r=json.loads(report.read_text());root.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
for name,ref in [('current',r['commits']['current']),('original',r['commits']['original'])]:
 dest=root/name;dest.mkdir()
 archive=subprocess.check_output(['git','archive',ref],cwd=repo)
 with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive)) as tar:
  members=[m for m in tar.getmembers() if m.name.split('/',1)[0] in {'src','scripts','tests'} or m.name in {'bench.js','package.json','benchmark-workloads.js'}]
  tar.extractall(dest,members=members,filter='data')
 (dest/'node_modules').symlink_to(repo/'node_modules',target_is_directory=True)
oldroot='/tmp/gma-bottosson-investigation-be03abd';oldrepo='/home/lloydk/work/gma-benchmark'
for name,source in r['scripts'].items():
 if name=='bootstrap.py':continue
 # Reproduce helpers and reference samples from the pinned current archive.
 source=source.replace(oldroot,str(root)).replace(oldrepo,str(root/'current'))
 (root/name).write_text(source)
for name in ['current','original']:
 (root/name/'benchmark-workloads.js').write_text((root/'current/benchmark-workloads.js').read_text())
 (root/name/'scripts').mkdir(exist_ok=True)
 (root/name/'scripts/kernel.mjs').write_text((root/'kernel.mjs').read_text())
for name in ['build.py','build-extra.py','build-call-shape.py','build-sector.py']:
 subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(root/name)],cwd=root,check=True)
for name in ['screen.py','screen-extra.py','repeat.py','full.py','call-shape.py']:
 subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(root/name)],cwd=root,check=True)
for runtime in ['node','bun']:
 for suffix,variants in [('main',['reuse-and-math','reuse-and-intersection']),('calls',['original-call-shape','sector-first','compact-calls'])]:
  with (root/f'compat-{suffix}-{runtime}.json').open('w') as out:
   subprocess.run([runtime,str(root/'compat.mjs'),*variants],stdout=out,cwd=root,check=True)
print('Raw measurements and compatibility results:',root)

(oklch, out, checkInGamut = false) {
		let L = oklch[0];
		const C = Math.max(0, oklch[1]);
		const H = oklch[2];

		if (checkInGamut && oklchToRgbIfInGamut(L, oklch[1], H, out)) return out;

		if (C <= EPSILON) {
			L = clamp01(L);
			const gray = clampedGamma(L * L * L);
			out[0] = gray;
			out[1] = gray;
			out[2] = gray;
			return out;
		}

		const hRad = H * Math.PI / 180;
		const unitA = Math.cos(hRad);
		const unitB = Math.sin(hRad);

		const cusp = findCuspRgb(unitA, unitB, H, cuspScratch);
		const L0 = clamp01(L);
		const t = findGamutIntersectionQ(unitA * KA0 + unitB * KB0, unitA * KA1 + unitB * KB1, unitA * KA2 + unitB * KB2, L, C, L0, cusp[0], cusp[1]);
		const mappedL = L0 + t * (L - L0);
		const mappedC = t * C;

		return oklabToClippedRgb(mappedL, mappedC * unitA, mappedC * unitB, out);
	}

notes: Production mapping code is untouched. All prototype modifications live in isolated scratch archives.

Initial screens use two mirrored sweeps and select candidates; the first exploratory screen overlapped four brief Node syntax checks while other variants were prepared. Repeated and full runs have no concurrent validation, builds or profiling.

Final focused repeat uses four processes per version/runtime/method/mode; full confirmation uses an ABBA with two processes per version/runtime/mode. All outputs are consumed, CPU 2, same path, fresh serial processes.
Call-count probes replace Math functions and are untimed source-work diagnostics, not exact machine-instruction counts.
Literal coefficients are P3-only diagnostics. No-contact-guard, legacy-radian-order and quantized-precheck ablations are not proposed production replacements.
Inlining helpers also removes overhead present before the port; its improvement is not all attributable to the port regression.
Bun call-shape effects are measured, but its generated machine code was not inspected. V8 heap-number evidence does not establish Bun heap allocation behavior.
No full Node/Bun/Rust suite rerun: this is an investigation; candidates were compared exactly on all three gamuts and both modes, including aliases and numerical edge probes.
